title: GitHub
load-failed: The GitHub connection could not be loaded: {reason}
unverifiable: The stored GitHub connection could not be verified ({code}). Disconnect it and connect again.
disconnect.title: Disconnect GitHub?
disconnect.body: The stored token is deleted on the hub and on every execution device at once. Revoke the app's authorization at GitHub as well.
disconnected-note: Disconnected. Also revoke the authorization of the app at GitHub.
devices.label: Execution device that runs the connection
devices.none: No execution device is online. Try again when one is back.
devices.failed: No execution device could be prepared: {reason}
code.hint: When GitHub asks which repositories the app may use, select the ones your agents need.
flow.title: Connect GitHub
read-failed: The state could not be read ({reason}); trying again.
code.expires.announce: The code expires in less than {minutes} min.
token.title: Use an existing GitHub token
token.intro: Paste a token of your GitHub account (for example the one of the GitHub CLI, `gh auth token`, or a personal access token). The execution device checks it at GitHub and stores it encrypted; it is never stored in the browser.
token.label: GitHub token
token.recommend: Recommended: a fine-grained personal access token limited to the repositories your agents need. A classic token reaches as far as your account; if a workgroup has a repository list, agents only reach the repositories on it.
token.empty: Paste a token first. A token consists of printable characters without spaces.
token.checking: The execution device is checking the token at GitHub…
token.failure.token_invalid: This is not a GitHub token.
token.failure.token_refused: GitHub refused the token: it was revoked, has expired or does not exist.
token.failure.scope_missing: The token lacks the scope "repo" (or "public_repo"). Create a token with access to repositories.
token.failure.sso_required: An organisation requires SSO authorisation of this token. Authorise it at GitHub (Settings → Tokens → Configure SSO) and try again.
token.failure.upstream_unreachable: The execution device could not reach GitHub. Try again later.
scopes.none.device_flow: Permissions: those of the GitHub App.
scopes.none.token: Fine-grained token: permissions as set at GitHub.
scopes.classic: A classic token reaches as far as your account. A fine-grained token is recommended.
composer.hint: This task looks like it needs GitHub, which is not connected yet. The task is sent anyway; connect GitHub so that it can go on.
waiting.connection.title: Connect GitHub so that the task can go on
waiting.connection.body: An operation of this task waits for your GitHub connection. Once it is connected, the task continues on its own.
waiting.done.connection: GitHub is connected – the task goes on.
waiting.expired.connection: Expired: GitHub was not connected in time.
waiting.connection.reconnect: The stored GitHub connection could not be used (expired or revoked). Connect GitHub again.
waiting.label: The task waits for you
